description: This bar chart illustrates the task count for different language families, categorized by the performance of three models—mBERT, XLM-R, and same—as indicated by the legend in the top right corner, where “better” refers to the model’s performance relative to the baseline. The horizontal axis lists nine language families: IE-Baltic, IE-Germanic, IE-Indic, IE-Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, presented in left-to-right alphabetical order. The vertical axis represents the “task count,” scaled linearly from 0 to 40, with tick marks at intervals of 10. Each language family has a group of three stacked bars representing the three models: mBERT (light gray), XLM-R (dark blue), and same (light green). The height of each stacked bar indicates the number of tasks assigned to that model for that language family. For example, for IE-Baltic, the mBERT bar is approximately 3, the XLM-R bar is approximately 10, and the same bar is approximately 7, totaling around 20. For IE-Slavic, the mBERT bar is approximately 12, the XLM-R bar is approximately 38, and the same bar is approximately 28, totaling around 78. The bars are not sorted; they are presented in the order of the language families on the horizontal axis. No bars are visually emphasized beyond their color coding and stacking structure.
